name: LAXASFIT Smartwatch Set – 2 Devices with 6 Straps
description:
LAXASFIT Smart Watch + Smart Sunglasses Combo
Package Contents

1 × Smartwatch

1 × Smart Sunglasses

6 × Interchangeable Straps

Key Features
Smart Sunglasses

Charging Time: 1–2 hours

Charging Type: USB Type-C

Design: Stylish and lightweight

Audio System: Built-in speakers

Connectivity: Bluetooth for hands-free calling

Additional Features: Play music, answer calls, and protect your eyes with UV and blue-light filtering lenses

Smartwatch

Charging Type: Magnetic wireless charger

Display: Full-color touch display

Notifications: Shows messages, calls, and app notifications

Health & Fitness Tracking: Heart rate monitoring, step counter, sleep tracking, and activity reminders

Compatibility: Works with both Android and iOS devices

Design & Convenience

Interchangeable Straps: Customize your look with 6 straps (various colors and materials)

User-Friendly: Both devices are easy to set up and pair via the LaxasFit app

Stylish & Functional: Perfect for daily wear, workouts, and hands-free connectivity

Charging & Battery

Smart Glasses: Fast charging (1–2 hours), long-lasting battery for calls and music

Smartwatch: Magnetic wireless charging ensures convenience and reduces wear on ports
